notes.subject: אם לא
notes.rationale: literally 'if not' — here an emphatic affirmation, 'surely', rendered 'жок эле' with the sense of a solemn oath-like denial

notes.subject: גמול
notes.rationale: 'weaned child' (from גמל, to wean) vs 'one dealt with/requited' (same root, to requite); KJV/JPS take 'weaned child', some read 'requited/dependent child'

notes.subject: נפש
notes.rationale: 'жан' for נפש, which is closer to throat/life-force/breathing self

notes.subject: כגמל ... כגמל
notes.rationale: the refrain 'like a weaned child' repeats, framing the simile; repetition kept in Kyrgyz

translation: Жок эле, мен жанымды түзөп тынчайттым — энеси жанында болгон, эмизүүдөн ажыраган бала сыяктуу; мага жаным ажыраган бала сыяктуу.
